Body: Dear Kumar K, Vasanth, Greetings! Hope you are doing well. Kindly provide your latest Statement of Account by completing the attached template with the relevant invoice details in Columns A to I and returning the completed file to us. Your prompt response will help us complete the reconciliation process in a timely manner. Thank you for your cooperation and support. Best Regards, Accounts Payable Team Capgemini Accounts Payable Team finance-analytics.agentic-assets@capgeminibsv.onmicrosoft.com
data.ai_intent_rationale: The email asks the supplier to provide their latest Statement of Account by completing and returning a template, indicating the primary intent is to obtain a statement from the supplier.
data.ai_rationale: The email requests a latest Statement of Account to complete the reconciliation process, a routine AP action needed soon.
